UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Public and private profile data for users (students, guardians, teachers, admins)

UsernameClaim.title: UsernameClaim
UsernameClaim.description: Atomic unique username registry mapping normalized lowercase handle to owning user UID

GuardianLink.title: GuardianLink
GuardianLink.description: Verified relationship linking a guardian to a student profile with granular privacy permissions

BoardRecord.title: BoardRecord
BoardRecord.description: Educational board definition (CBSE, CISCE, ICSE, ISC, State Boards)

ClassRecord.title: ClassRecord
ClassRecord.description: Class/Grade definition belonging to an education board

SubjectRecord.title: SubjectRecord
SubjectRecord.description: Academic subject belonging to a board and grade

SyllabusNode.title: SyllabusNode
SyllabusNode.description: Chapter, topic, and learning objective curriculum node with verified syllabus state

LearningProfile.title: LearningProfile
LearningProfile.description: Student learning pace, strengths, weaknesses, and personalized daily goals

StudyPlan.title: StudyPlan
StudyPlan.description: Personalized study schedule and task list for a student

ActivityRecord.title: ActivityRecord
ActivityRecord.description: Verified UID-scoped student learning activity event with idempotency key and local date key

DoubtTicket.title: DoubtTicket
DoubtTicket.description: Student question submitted to AI doubt solver or teacher (never stores raw uploaded binary documents)

TeacherSession.title: TeacherSession
TeacherSession.description: Personal AI Teacher multi-turn tutoring conversation session bound to student profile

PracticeRecord.title: PracticeRecord
PracticeRecord.description: Quiz and mock exam practice attempt records

AdminRecord.title: AdminRecord
AdminRecord.description: Lookup document that designates an authenticated user as an Eduverse platform administrator

MindMap.title: MindMap
MindMap.description: Hierarchical concept mind map created or generated by a student for a specific board, class, and subject

PracticeAttempt.title: PracticeAttempt
PracticeAttempt.description: Individual adaptive practice question attempt with difficulty, correctness, time spent, and error classification

TopicMastery.title: TopicMastery
TopicMastery.description: Transparent aggregated topic mastery state, recurring error log, revision count, and historical snapshots

Flashcard.title: Flashcard
Flashcard.description: Active-recall flashcard with SM-2 spaced repetition schedule and difficulty tracking

FlashcardReview.title: FlashcardReview
FlashcardReview.description: Immutable review log recording active recall rating and scheduled interval transition

ExamAttempt.title: ExamAttempt
ExamAttempt.description: Server-validated AI practice exam attempt with graded question results, topic/difficulty breakdowns, and mistake analysis (never an official board exam)

VoiceSession.title: VoiceSession
VoiceSession.description: Text-only voice classroom conversation transcript and metadata (raw audio recordings are never stored)

StudyRoom.title: StudyRoom
StudyRoom.description: Private invitation-only collaborative study space with public DMs disabled

StudyRoomMembershipIndex.title: StudyRoomMembershipIndex
StudyRoomMembershipIndex.description: Per-user private index of joined study rooms (avoids public room scraping)

StudyRoomMember.title: StudyRoomMember
StudyRoomMember.description: Privacy-safe study room participant projection (excludes email, phone, and private profile details)

StudyRoomInvite.title: StudyRoomInvite
StudyRoomInvite.description: Secret invitation token granting join access to a private study room

StudyRoomNote.title: StudyRoomNote
StudyRoomNote.description: Moderated collaborative note shared inside a private study room

StudyRoomGoal.title: StudyRoomGoal
StudyRoomGoal.description: Collaborative study milestone shared inside a private room

StudyRoomQuiz.title: StudyRoomQuiz
StudyRoomQuiz.description: Peer group quiz hosted inside a private study room

StudyRoomMindMap.title: StudyRoomMindMap
StudyRoomMindMap.description: Concept mind map shared with members of a private study room

StudyRoomReport.title: StudyRoomReport
StudyRoomReport.description: Content or member safety report submitted for host/moderator review

AchievementState.title: AchievementState
AchievementState.description: Persisted healthy motivation metrics, unlocked badge timestamps, and verified milestones

QuestionBankItem.title: QuestionBankItem
QuestionBankItem.description: Admin-curated verified question bank record across CBSE/ICSE/State Class 6-12

LearningContentItem.title: LearningContentItem
LearningContentItem.description: Curated formula sheet, concept guide, solved example, or revision note

ModerationReport.title: ModerationReport
ModerationReport.description: Platform-wide student safety or AI moderation report

AdminAuditLog.title: AdminAuditLog
AdminAuditLog.description: Immutable append-only administrative security audit trail

GuardianInviteCode.title: GuardianInviteCode
GuardianInviteCode.description: Single-use expiring verification code generated by a student for guardian linking

LessonProgress.title: LessonProgress
LessonProgress.description: UID-scoped chapter/topic lesson start and completion progress record

RecommendationHistory.title: RecommendationHistory
RecommendationHistory.description: UID-scoped recommendation presentation, completion, and skip cooldown state

DailyGoalRecord.title: DailyGoalRecord
DailyGoalRecord.description: UID-scoped timezone-keyed daily learning goal snapshot

VisualExploration.title: VisualExploration
VisualExploration.description: AI-generated and student-saved interactive visual learning exploration scoped to userId
